title: Listed coordinates are fixed
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\rho$ assign one of the three restriction states to each of the $n$ coordinates, let $L$ be a list of coordinates, and let $x\in(\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})^n$. Every coordinate belonging to $L$ is nonfree after successively fixing the listed coordinates according to the signs encoded by $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $\rho$ is a restriction assignment on $n$ coordinates
